page: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a GPU-accelerated server belonging to the Cloud GPU family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 30 dedicated physical cores from an AMD EPYC 9124 processor running at 2.75 GHz. The system is equipped with 180.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it integrates two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across compute and memory tasks. The AMD EPYC processor achieves top 25% results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core evaluations, as well as in Passmark CPU tests, including extended instructions, encryption, and physics. Memory performance is mixed, with small-block cached read bandwidth placing in the top 25%, while large-block uncached read and write bandwidths remain in the middle 50%. Database operations and Redis SET operations both rank in the top 25%, demonstrating highly efficient transactional processing.

The dual NVIDIA L40S GPUs deliver top-tier performance in large language model (LLM) inference. Benchmarks for prompt processing and text generation across small, medium, and large models consistently place in the top 10% of tested systems. This makes the server highly cost-efficient for specialized AI workloads, offering a dense allocation of GPU memory and dedicated compute resources without the overhead of larger multi-node clusters.
This hardware configuration is optimized for demanding workloads such as LLM inference, machine learning model training, high-performance database operations, and multi-threaded data decompression.
description: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a GPU-accelerated server designed for high-performance computing and AI workloads. It features 30 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor running at 2.75 GHz, paired with 180.0 GB of system memory and a 400 GB NVMe SSD. The server's primary strength lies in its dual NVIDIA L40S GPUs, which provide a total of 96 GB of VRAM. Benchmark data shows top-tier performance in LLM inference across various model sizes, alongside strong multi-core CPU execution and database operations. With a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, this KVM-based server offers a balanced, resource-dense profile for parallel processing. It is highly suited for machine learning inference, deep learning, and intensive database workloads.
